programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Sharyn Alfonsi, Anderson Cooper, Steve Kroft, Lara Logan, Norah O'Donnell, Scott Pelley, Charlie Rose, Lesley Stahl, Jon Wertheim, Oprah Winfrey and Bill Whitaker.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now

The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.desc: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption.

programme.title: While The City Sleeps
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in New York City. Dubbed The Lipstick Killer, he has also strangely become the center of a power struggle between three division chiefs in a media empire. The directive from their inexperienced boss, Walter Kyne (Vincent Price), is simple: Whoever catches the killer gets promoted to executive editor. But newspaper editor John Day Griffith (Thomas Mitchell) has one distinct advantage in the form of crack reporter Edward Mobley (Dana Andrews).

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Crowded Sky
programme.desc: When Navy pilot Dale Heath (Efrem Zimbalist Jr.) takes off, he doesn't expect his navigational equipment to fail, and must adapt when it goes out along with his radio. Heading straight for a commercial jet piloted by Dick Barnett (Dana Andrews), whose plane is full of passengers, Heath can't tell which way to turn in order to avoid a catastrophe. Subplots including Barnett's co-pilot Mike's (John Kerr) relationship with a flight attendant (Anne Francis), buoy this tense airborne thriller.

programme.title: Enchanted Island
programme.desc: Two 19th-century sailors (Dana Andrews, Don Dubbins) jump ship to an island and find cannibals and a princess (Jane Powell).

programme.title: Brainstorm
programme.desc: A scientist (Jeffrey Hunter) plans to kill his suicidal lover's (Anne Francis) rotten husband (Dana Andrews), then fake insanity.

programme.title: Laura
programme.desc: In one of the most celebrated 1940s film noirs, Manhattan detective Mark McPherson (Dana Andrews) investigates the murder of Madison Avenue executive Laura Hunt (Gene Tierney) in her fashionable apartment. On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). As the detective grows obsessed with the case, he finds himself falling in love with the dead woman.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Novelist Tom Garrett (Dana Andrews) and publisher Austin Spencer (Sidney Blackmer) intend to show how lawyer Roy Thompson (Philip Bourneuf) has been using circumstantial evidence in capital punishment trials. They concoct a scheme in which flimsy evidence will point to Garrett as a murder suspect, but Spencer will exonerate him at the end. Meanwhile, they keep the plan a secret from Spencer's daughter, Susan (Joan Fontaine), who is engaged to Garrett. However, the trial doesn't go as planned.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Loved One
programme.desc: The suicide of his expatriate uncle (John Gielgud) draws Englishman and poet Dennis Barlow (Robert Morse) into California's booming funeral industry. Dennis falls for spiritual funeral home stylist Aimee (Anjanette Comer), whose boss, Mr. Joyboy (Rod Steiger), also has designs on her. Meanwhile, he's drawn into a crooked scheme by the cemetery's owner, Henry Glenworthy (Jonathan Winters), to shoot corpses into space and build a retirement home on the cemetery land.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Sealed Cargo
programme.desc: During World War II, Pat Bannon (Dana Andrews) is the captain of the Daniel Webster, a fishing boat off the coast of Massachusetts. Short on men for a journey to Newfoundland, he hires Conrad (Philip Dorn), a stranded Danish sailor, to work on his ship. He also agrees to transport a woman named Margaret (Carla Balenda) to a remote Newfoundland village. But when Bannon learns that his boat's radio system has been sabotaged, he begins to suspect there may be a traitor on board.

programme.title: Westward Passage
programme.desc: Nick Allen (Laurence Olivier) is an idealistic writer who refuses to give in to the commercial advice of his editor. His loving wife, Olivia (Ann Harding), supports his artistic integrity, but, after the birth of their daughter, she begs Nick to be practical. The resulting strain leads to divorce. Six years later, Olivia, who has since remarried, and Nick, now a successful author, cross paths on a fateful trip to Switzerland. Still in love, Nick strives to win back Olivia's heart.

programme.title: Call It a Day
programme.desc: An actress, a bachelor and an artist flirt with an Englishman (Ian Hunter), his wife and their daughter (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: Merrily We Live
programme.desc: The wealthy Kilbourne family is tired of Mrs. Kilbourne (Billie Burke) hiring ex-convicts as servants. After a servant steals the family's silver, Mrs. Kilbourne agrees to never hire another drifter for help. But when a rough-looking man named Rawlins (Brian Aherne) arrives at her doorstep, she cannot help but hire him as the new chauffeur. As Rawlins catches the eye of their oldest daughter, Jerry (Constance Bennett), the Kilbournes realize that he may not be the vagrant he claims to be.

programme.title: My Bill
programme.desc: Mary (Kay Francis) was relatively well off, until her husband died in the middle of the Great Depression. Now she finds herself with four kids and quickly diminishing resources. She sends the three eldest children to stay with a wealthy aunt, but the youngest boy, Bill (Dickie Moore), remains with her. Mother and son try to make a go of it amidst the gossip and censure of the townsfolk. Fortunately, Bill befriends a rich elderly woman who desperately needs companionship.

programme.title: Angels Wash Their Faces
programme.desc: New York land baron Alfredo Martino (Eduardo Ciannelli) has started burning down his own buildings and cashing in on the insurance, but he needs a fall guy. He finds the perfect target in Gabe Ryan (Frankie Thomas), a nice kid with a troubled past and a bad habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time. Gabe's big sister, Joy (Ann Sheridan), then teams up with her brother's ragtag juvenile hall pals (The Dead End Kids) and lawyer, Pat Remson (Ronald Reagan), to clear the boy's name.

programme.title: Down in San Diego
programme.desc: A guy (Ray McDonald) and his girlfriend (Bonita Granville) thwart a wartime spy ring at a California Navy base.

programme.title: Seven Miles From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Alcatraz inmates Champ and Jimbo, who were gangsters on the outside, learn about the attack on Pearl Harbor and get the idea that the island prison they call home is sure to be the next attack site. They break out of jail and make it to a tiny lighthouse isle, where they take the few inhabitants hostage. But when Champ and Jimbo uncover a Nazi plot to take over the lighthouse, the crooks must choose to either flee or stay put and stick up for their country.

programme.title: Hitler's Children
programme.desc: Anna Muller (Bonita Granville), a U.S. citizen studying at the American Colony School in Germany, befriends both a teacher, "Nicky" Nichols (Kent Smith), and Karl Bruner (Tim Holt), a student at a neighboring school who joins the Hitler Youth. Years after they graduate, Karl returns as a Nazi officer and sends Anna -- now a teacher herself -- to a labor camp. While Karl praises the changes in Anna, Nicky works in secret to help her escape from the Nazis.

programme.title: Youth Runs Wild
programme.desc: The teens of a defense-plant town hop on the road to juvenile delinquency while their parents are busy with the war.

programme.title: The Truth About Murder
programme.desc: A district attorney (Morgan Conway) opposes his lawyer girlfriend (Bonita Granville) on a case until a polygraph ends it.

programme.title: These Three
programme.desc: Martha (Miriam Hopkins) and Karen (Merle Oberon) graduate from college and turn an old Massachusetts farm into a school for girls. The friends are aided in their venture by local doctor Joe Cardin (Joel McCrea), who begins a relationship with Karen, and a prominent woman whose granddaughter, Mary (Bonita Granville), later enrolls in the new school. Mary soon reveals herself to be a spiteful child and tells a scandalous lie about Martha and Joe that threatens to destroy the lives of all involved.

programme.title: Beloved Brat
programme.desc: Roberta (Bonita Granville) is raised in a wealthy home, and she is ignored by her busy parents. As her behavior worsens, she is placed in a boarding school for troubled girls, and she is given responsibilities to teach her manners.

programme.title: Nancy Drew, Detective
programme.desc: Teen sleuth Nancy Drew (Bonita Granville), always eager to solve a mystery, grows suspicious when eccentric dowager Mary Eldridge (Helena Phillips Evans) vanishes after promising a small fortune to Nancy's school. Though Miss Eldridge's accountant claims she's gone away for her health, Nancy senses foul play when a lost carrier pigeon delivers a cryptic clue. Despite the warnings of her dad (John Litel) and her pal Ted (Frankie Thomas), Nancy can't stop herself from investigating.

programme.title: Nancy Drew -- Reporter
programme.desc: Girl sleuth Nancy Drew (Bonita Granville) is always on the case when a mystery springs up in River Heights. This time, Nancy enters an amateur journalism contest and runs smack into a plot to frame an innocent young woman for murder. With the aid of her long-suffering chum, Ted (Frank Thomas Jr.), and some legal advice from her attorney dad (John Litel), Nancy nabs an elusive piece of evidence that she hopes will prove the identity of the real killer -- and win her the journalism prize to boot.

programme.title: Nancy Drew, Trouble Shooter
programme.desc: There's a murder in a small town, local man Matt Brandon (Aldrich Bowker) is accused, and he has personal friend and reputed attorney Carson Drew (John Litel) as his lawyer. Drew and his plucky teenage daughter, Nancy (Bonita Granville), head out to see what's going on. But the elder Drew isn't the only one interested in solving the case; young Nancy bands together with her friend Ted Nickerson (Frankie Thomas) to see if they themselves can unravel the mystery and save the day.

programme.title: Nancy Drew and the Hidden Staircase
programme.desc: Based on the popular book by Carolyn Keene, this mystery finds amateur sleuth Nancy Drew determined to rope her boyfriend, Ted, into helping her investigate the strange occurrences that elderly sisters Rosemary and Floretta Turnbull have been experiencing in their Victorian-era house. When the Turnbulls are accused of murder, Nancy must act quickly to save the sisters from jail and discover who's been breaking into their home.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Back home after two years of military service, Andy Hardy (Mickey Rooney) anticipates returning to college and his girlfriend, Kay (Bonita Granville). Andy's subsequent erratic behavior convinces his alarmed parents, James (Lewis Stone) and Emily (Fay Holden), that they must interfere, but Andy expresses his determination to propose to Kay. Back at college, Andy is disappointed when Kay temporarily goes home. When Kay returns with surprising news, Andy realizes he has much to learn about love.

programme.title: Of Human Hearts
programme.desc: When preacher Ethan Wilkins (Walter Huston) relocates to a small, hardscrabble town on the Ohio River, he's surprised by the poor treatment he gets from the locals, but bears it quietly. His son, Jason (James Stewart), however, hates the town. Against his father's wishes, he aspires to be a doctor, and demands that his mother (Beulah Bondi) sell off her few possessions to pay for his education. When the Civil War breaks out, he finds success as a surgeon, but is estranged from his family.

programme.title: Vivacious Lady
programme.desc: Peter is a professor who gets hitched to a singer named Francey on a whim while visiting New York City. But when Peter returns home, he is less than eager to introduce his new bride to his domineering father, whom he knows will not approve. He also has to contend with his jealous former fiancée. As Peter tries to keep his married status a secret, a number of amusing missteps happen along the way.

programme.title: You Can't Take It With You
programme.desc: Sweet-natured Alice Sycamore (Jean Arthur) falls for banker's son Tony Kirby (James Stewart). But when she invites her snooty prospective in-laws to dinner to give their blessing to the marriage, Alice's peculiar extended family -- including philosophical grandfather Martin Vanderhof (Lionel Barrymore), hapless fledgling ballerina sister Essie (Ann Miller) and fireworks enthusiast father, Paul (Samuel S. Hinds) -- might be too eccentric for the staid Kirbys.

programme.title: The Shop Around the Corner
programme.desc: Alfred Kralik and Klara Novak are employees at Matuschek and Company, a general store in Budapest. Klara and Alfred are constantly at odds with each other, butting heads and disagreeing on almost everything. Both are enamored of their respective pen pals, who serve as welcome distractions in their lives. Little do they know, they are each the other's pen pal and, despite outward differences, have unwittingly fallen in love through their letters.

programme.title: The Stratton Story
programme.desc: This fact-based sports drama chronicles the life of famous pitcher Monty Stratton. Stratton (James Stewart), a star athlete, loses his leg when his hunting rifle misfires during a wilderness outing. Initially, Stratton's career is derailed, and he wallows in the depth of depression; however, with the encouragement of his loving spouse, Ethel (June Allyson), he decides to get back in the game. Equipped with a prosthetic leg, Stratton eventually works his way back to pitching in the minor leagues.

programme.title: Carbine Williams
programme.desc: Leading the troubled life of a moonshiner, David Marshall Williams (James Stewart) winds up in jail after a raid on his operation results in the death of an investigating officer. While serving time, the headstrong Williams gains the attention of warden H.T. Peoples (Wendell Corey), who sees unrealized potential in the convict and gives him access to a tool shop. While tinkering away, Williams manages to invent the M1 carbine rifle, which became a standard U.S. firearm in World War II.

programme.title: Bell, Book and Candle
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Gillian Holroyd (Kim Novak) is a modern-day witch living in New York City's Greenwich Village. When she encounters charming publisher Shepherd Henderson (James Stewart), she decides to make him hers by casting a love spell. Gillian takes added pleasure in doing so because Henderson is engaged to her old college rival (Janice Rule). However, Gillian finds herself actually falling for Shepherd, which poses a problem: She will lose her powers if she falls in love.

Unfortunately, Gregory's been sitting behind a desk since World War II ended, and he soon learns he's too out of shape to serve. Now, as Katy searches for a loophole that will free her from the Army, Gregory haplessly tries to take her place on the home front.

programme.title: Three Coins in the Fountain

Soon, Maria is pursued by a dashing prince (Louis Jourdan), Anita finds herself involved with a forbidden coworker (Rossano Brazzi), and Frances receives a surprising proposal from her boss (Clifton Webb). All three women vow to one day return to Rome.

programme.title: Love Is a Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: In Hong Kong in 1949, Mark Elliott is an American reporter covering the Chinese civil war. Undergoing a trial separation from his wife, he meets the beautiful Dr. Han Suyin, a widowed physician from mainland China. As the pair fall in love, they encounter disapproval from both her family and his friends about their interracial romance. Although the film was a commercial success upon release, the casting of Jones in an Asian role has since been criticized.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study…from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home…a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: Production And Decay Of Strange Particles
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.sub-title: ¡Todo el mundo debe volver en sí! El agua sagrada del Templo de Dios

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Piccolo han engañado a Garlick y aprovechan la confusión para robarle las botellas donde ha encerrado al Todopoderoso y a Poppo. A Poppo se le ocurre una idea para que el Agua Ultradivina cumpla su cometido.
programme.sub-title: ¡Mañana será demasiado tarde! Dios emprende una acción suicida

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El demonio Garlick se ha convertido en un poderoso gigante que recibe cada vez más poder de la Estrella de la Magia Negra. Además todos sus secuaces son ahora más peligrosos que antes y el combate se complica cada vez más.
programme.sub-title: ¡La victoria requiere medidas extremas! Dios rompe la ley sagrada

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La Estrella de la Magia Negra ya está muy cerca de la Tierra y el combate contra Garlick no tiene fin. Son Gohan es un rival muy digno, pero la inmortalidad del enemigo es el mayor problema, porque aunque le venzan, se levantará una y otra vez...
programme.sub-title: ¡El agua sagrada funciona! El mundo despierta de la pesadilla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de la batalla con Garlick, los guerreros vuelven a su vida habitual. Krilín con su novia Maron, Son Gohan vuelve a sus estudios y Piccolo no cesa su vigilancia. El Maestro Tortuga les llama a todos para celebrar el cumpleaños de su tortuga
programme.sub-title: ¡Una breve posibilidad de victoria para Gohan! Derrota al mundo demoníaco

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilin busca la manera de proponerle matrimonio a Marron.
programme.sub-title: Eres un hombre ¿no?... La proposición 101ª de Krilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Un año después de la batalla de Namek, Gohan y sus amigos detectan una energía increíblemente poderosa y maligna que se acerca a la Tierra. Sus peores temores se confirman cuando descubren que Freeza ha sobrevivido.
programme.sub-title: Ésa es la Tierra, papá... Freeza padre e hijo contraatacan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: A falta de tres horas para que Goku regrese, la Tierra se enfrenta a la peor de las crisis en la forma de un revivido Freeza acompañado por su padre. Pero justo cuando todo parece perdido, aparece un misterioso joven que les planta cara.
programme.sub-title: Yo derrotaré a Freeza... El misterioso joven que espera a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando Freeza y su padre aterrizan en la Tierra, lo único que se interpone entre ellos y su diabólica venganza es un muchacho desconocido. Pero el joven héroe demuestra ser más de lo que aparenta al transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡Freeza partido en dos de un solo golpe! Aparece otro Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras acabar fácilmente con Freeza y su padre, el misterioso Super Saiyan anuncia el lugar y la hora exacta de llegada de Goku a la Tierra. Pero cuando Goku llega tal y como ha predicho, él tampoco parece tener ni idea de quién es el joven.
programme.sub-title: Ey, cuánto tiempo... Son Goku regresa

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El enigma que envuelve al Super Saiyan misterioso queda finalmente resuelto. Se trata de Trunks, hijo de Bulma y Vegeta, que ha viajado veinte años hacia atrás en el tiempo para advertir a Goku de una terrible amenaza que aguarda en el futuro.
programme.sub-title: Mi padre es Vegeta. La confesión del misterioso joven

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku pone a sus amigos al corriente de la profecía el joven del futuro según la cual aparecerán dos enemigos terroríficos al cabo de tres años. Todos deciden entrenarse a fondo en los tres años que faltan para la llegada de los androides.
programme.sub-title: ¿La nueva técnica especial de Goku? Mirad mi Cambio de Lugar Instantáneo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Advertidos por el joven del futuro, Goku, Piccolo, Gohan, Vegeta y el resto de Guerreros Z comienzan un duro entrenamiento de tres años para que el futuro infernal del que procede Trunks jamás llegue a hacerse realidad.
programme.sub-title: ¡Superaré a Goku! El rey de la raza guerrera saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras haberse enfrentado al mismísimo Freeza y haber salvado la Tierra en numerosas ocasiones, Goku se enfrenta ahora al desafío más grande de su vida: sacarse el permiso de conducir para no tener que hacer frente a la ira de Chichi.
programme.sub-title: ¿Sacarse el permiso? El nuevo desafío de Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Han pasado tres años y el día fatídico finalmente ha llegado. Tal y como había predicho Trunks, los androides aparecen y Yamcha se convierte en la primera víctima de la masacre. ¿Cuál es el terrible poder oculto de los androides?
programme.sub-title: Asesinos que no dejan rastro. ¿Quiénes son los androides?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando los Guerreros Z finalmente localizan a los androides, el despiadado nº 20 les provoca destruyendo la mitad de la ciudad. Goku responde a los androides sorprendiéndoles con una transformación en Super Saiyan llena de rabia.
programme.sub-title: Las atrocidades del sanguinario Nº 20. La supertransformación llena de rabia de Son Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Super Saiyan Goku y el Nº 19 comienzan a librar una intensa batalla. Pero cuando Goku comienza a perder terreno y a comportarse de un modo extraño, Gohan comprende que es debido a la enfermedad cardíaca que predijo Trunks.
programme.sub-title: ¡La doble conmoción de Goku! Atrapado entre la enfermedad y la adversidad

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Afectado por una enfermedad cardíaca viral, Goku se encuentra indefenso frente al Androide Nº 19. Pero justo entonces aparece Vegeta y sorprende a todos demostrando que él también es capaz de transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡El poder de Vegeta! Despierta la sangre de un Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: En su primera batalla como Super Saiyan, Vegeta aplasta literalmente al Nº 19, pero el Nº 20 escapa y se esconde entre las montañas. Ahora, los Guerreros Z deben encontrarle antes de que pueda llevar a cabo sus diabólicos planes.
programme.sub-title: La risa desafiante del Nº 20... El secreto del Dr. Gero

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan y compañía continúan la búsqueda de un Nº 20 más dispuesto a ser el cazador que la presa. Mientras tanto, Trunks regresa a tiempo de descubrir que el pasado ha cambiado y no necesariamente para mejor.
programme.sub-title: ¿Una realidad aún más aterradora que el futuro? La sospecha de Trunks

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La revelación de que el Nº 19 es el Dr. Gero y que los androides que convierten el futuro en un infierno son el Nº 17 y el Nº 18 hace que sea más importante que nunca encontrar el laboratorio secreto antes de que el científico regrese a él.
programme.sub-title: ¡Hay que dar con él! La búsqueda del misterioso laboratorio del Dr. Gero

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando los Guerreros Z finalmente encuentran el laboratorio secreto del Dr. Gero, Vegeta, desoyendo el sensato consejo de Trunks, permite que el científico active a los Androides Nº 17 y Nº 18, que no tardan en tomar el control de la situación.
programme.sub-title: Y los temores se hacen realidad... ¡El Nº 17 y el Nº 18 despiertan!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los Androides Nº 17 y Nº 18, e incluso el Nº 16 del que ni siquiera Trunks había oído hablar, han sido finalmente activados. ¿Existirá alguien capaz de impedir que cumplan el objetivo de asesinar a Goku para el que han sido programados?
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Es demasiado tarde para hacer algo?! El arma definitiva para matar a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La terrible batalla entre Super Saiyan Vegeta y la Nº 18 finalmente ha dado comienzo. A pesar de que Trunks y los otros desean intervenir, Vegeta insiste en luchar solo contra un enemigo que aparentemente no tiene ningún punto débil.
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Atractiva y superpoderosa?! La Nº 18 no tiene ningún punto débil

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de que Vegeta sea humillado por la Nº 18, Trunks, Piccolo y Ten Shin Han deciden intervenir y sufren el mismo destino que él. Para los androides todo parece ser un juego que tiene como premio final la cabeza de Goku.
programme.sub-title: Nadie puede detenerles... ¡¿Es el fin de los Guerreros Z?!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Frente al inconcebible poder de los androides, los orgullos heridos dejan paso a las medidas desesperadas. Piccolo tiene intención de volver a ser uno de nuevo con Dios para adquirir un poder que rivalice con el de los Super Saiyans.
programme.sub-title: ¡La decisión de Piccolo! El último as bajo la manga

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Sin prisa pero sin pausa, los androides se van acercando cada vez más a un Goku convaleciente e indefenso. Klilyn y los otros deciden trasladar a su amigo inconsciente a la Kame House para protegerlo de la amenaza de los androides.
programme.sub-title: ¡Las super-armas de destrucción masiva andantes! Los androides se aproximan a Goku

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet im Jahr 1956 und nimmt die Gestalt von "Erstsemester" Arnold an. Dieser ist stets darum bemüht, Unschuldige vor Bösem zu bewahren. Sams Aufgabe besteht zum Teil darin, die Studenten zu mehr Umsicht mit sich selbst zu bewegen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Liz Tate wird vorgeworfen, dass sie ihre Zellennachbarin Carol Benning ermordet hat. Liz ist jedoch unschuldig. Der wahre Täter ist ein Gefängnisaufseher und heißt Meyers. Er hatte eine Affäre mit Carol. Nun will er die Schuld auf Liz schieben.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1960 und soll den Selbstmordversuch von Marilyn Monroe verhindern. Er schlüpft in den Körper von Dennis Boardman, ihrem Chauffeur. Marilyn befindet sich auf einer der berüchtigten Partys von Peter Lawford.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Dieses Mal reist Sam in das Jahr 1862, um das Schicksal seiner eigenen Familie zu ändern. Im Körper seines Urgroßvaters Captain John Beckett soll er das Herz von Olivia erobern. Die hat ihn ursprünglich fesseln lassen, weil er ein Nordstaatler ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1954 und schlüpft in den Körper des noch unbekannten Elvis Presley. Er soll der talentierten Musikerin Sue Allen Winters die Türen ins Showbusiness öffnen, da sie unter extremem Lampenfieber leidet.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet nach einem weiteren Zeitsprung in einer Bergarbeiterkneipe, bleibt aber er selbst. Als plötzlich ein Grubenunglück passiert, muss Sam die Männer retten, die sich noch unter Tage befinden. Damit ist seine Mission aber noch nicht erfüllt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Durch ein Experiment gelangt Sam Beckett in das Jahr 1956. Er selbst kann sich an nichts erinnern. Ihm wird erst langsam bewusst, dass es sich um eine Zeitreise handeln muss. Als Pilot Tom Stratton muss Sam ein Flugprogramm durchführen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam ist im Jahr 1972 und in der Person eines Professor. Er muss eine Hochzeit mit einer Studentin verhindern, da sonst beide nicht glücklich werden würden. Als Sam in der Person des Professors seine Jugendliebe trifft, wird die Aufgabe komplizierter.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam wacht als Boxer Cody auf. Cody steht vor einem Kampf. Der zwielichtige Jake Edwards will, dass Cody den Kampf verliert, um hohe Wettgewinne einzustreichen. Sam entwickelt einen gefährlichen Plan und muss plötzlich auf Alberts Hilfe verzichten.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam gelangt im Jahr 1955 in den Süden der USA und soll einen Verkehrsunfall verhindern. Im Körper eines Schwarzen erfährt er die Folgen der Rassentrennung. Dann wird er aufgrund der Rassengesetze festgenommen, bevor er seinen Auftrag erfüllen kann.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam wacht als Teenager Cameron auf. Er soll verhindern, dass die Schwester einen gewalttätigen Mann heiratet. Durch eine List kann er der Schwester die Augen öffnen. Dazu muss er den Teenager noch mit einer Freundin aus der Schule zusammenbringen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam hilft einer geschiedenen Mutter, deren kauziger Sohn einen fatalen Fehler macht, als er versucht, sich dem Gruppenzwang an der Schule zu beugen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam findet sich 1962 im Körper des Quarterbacks Eddie Vega wieder. Seine Mission ist es, seinen Teamkollegen Chuey davon abzuhalten, absichtlich das nächste Spiel zu verlieren, um den Miethai Ruben de Guerra zufriedenzustellen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: September 1973: FBI Agent Peter Langley - alias Sam - erhält die Aufgabe, Dana zu beschützen. Die junge Frau möchte gegen ihren ehemaligen Chef, den Drogenschmuggler Nick Kochifos, aussagen. Dieser hat sie schon zweimal ausfindig machen können.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: George erwacht 1970 im Körper von George Washakie. Er wurde mit Georges Großvater ins Gefängnis gebracht, weil sie sich ein Auto "ausgeliehen" haben. Sie können allerdings aus dem Gefängnis fliehen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Die Leiche Hilla Danners liegt eines Tages vor dem Leichenbestatter Melvin Spooner, alias Sam. Er sieht anhand der Wunden im Gesicht, dass sie ermordet worden sein muss und beschließt, den Mörder ausfindig zu machen.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Depois de alguns momentos de uma suposta paz, os problemas voltam a perturbar a ordem em Alexandria. Mas o maior problema é que, dessa vez, a ameaça talvez seja excessivamente grande para ser derrotada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Durante uma missão de resgate de um companheiro desaparecido, o grupo se depara com uma perigosa horda de zumbis. Porém, o que os humanos encontram é uma ameaça surpreendente, a qual pode colocar todos em perigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick fica surpreso ao descobrir que Alexandria não é um lugar tão seguro quanto ele havia imaginado. Com isso, precisa tomar importantes decisões sobre o que fazer e para onde ir.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o seu grupo percebem que, para manter a paz em Alexandria, é preciso lutar contra um novo inimigo. No entanto, eles também precisam considerar que o maior problema em relação a esse enfrentamento é que, dessa vez, o grupo está em minoria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Dois grupos separados deixam Alexandria em busca de suprimentos. Embora todos estejam preocupados com o futuro da comunidade, o perigo imediato os ameaça. Os caminhos de Daryl e de seu grupo cruzam com os de Dwight.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o grupo devem sair da cidade para salvar um dos seus. O que eles experimentarão na estrada pode mudar suas vidas para sempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.sub-title: Vai Chegar o Dia em que Você Não Existirá

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Um novo grupo de sobreviventes parece ter absolutamente tudo em sua impressionante comunidade. Mas todos logo descobrem que nesse lugar, para tudo o que é oferecido, um preço alto precisa ser pago.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
